derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G2596 (κατά) and G2572 (καλύπτω);

occurrences.text: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
